texto: Good afternoon! My name is Paulo. I am from Brazil. In my English class, we practice capital letters and small letters. I know the vowels and consonants. How are you? I am very happy today. Nice to meet you!

preguntas_vf.pregunta: The students practice capital letters and small letters
He is in an English class

texto: We are at the supermarket. The name of this supermarket is "The big S". The watermelons and oranges are on sale. The carrots are in front of the tomatoes. I check the regular price of the milk and the bread. It is a good day to shop.

preguntas_vf.pregunta: The carrots are behind the tomatoes.
It is a good day to shop.

texto: Hi! Let me tell you about my friend Alex. My friend is from Germany, but now he lives in China. His favorite food are American meat and Guatemalan apples. He eats them every Sunday. His favorite number is 100. He is a very kind person. How old is he? He is 30 years old. We are good friends, and we like to study English together when we connect on Teams or Whatsapp.

Let me give you a tour by my favorite store. This is 'The Global Bakery'. The bread here is very good. The owner is Mr. Cook; he is from Greece, but the coffee is from Brazil. On Thursdays, the Japanese rice cookies are on sale, and on Fridays you can buy Italian paninis! Today is Tuesday, and the bakery is very busy. People love to buy French products like the baguettes. They are delicious! I need 11 croissants for a meeting. The price is fourteen dollars ($14). I have a coupon: $14 minus $3.50 is $10.50. They always give coupons to the regular customers. Now you see why this is my favorite bakery!

preguntas_opcion_multiple.pregunta: How much does the speaker pay after using the coupon?

preguntas_vf.pregunta: On Tuesdays Italian products are on sale.
You can buy Chinese cookies on Thursdays
Today is Tuesday and I buy French products
